The printed source-review results are retained; no refused review or judged hash was fabricated.

All 13 layers use votes not_returned with explanatory votes_note, and no survived/refuted outcomes in this stopped ledger entry. Actual vote outcomes remain in the returns and dated manifest. The stopped sweep neither counts nor resets saturation.

North-star action: preserve evidence needed to select and trial skills for complex-system engineering and US-equities research and historical simulation. Skills adoption remains governed by separate paired benchmarks and trial decisions.
